{{Quote|Signal benchmarks attained. Variance acceptable. Combat systems aligned. We are HELIOS-3D.|HELIOS-3D|<ref name="HtH3" />}}
'''HELIOS-3D''', or simply '''3D''', was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who joined [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Republic Senate Building hostage siege]], an operation to rescue [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]].

==Biography==
===Coruscant===
{{Quote|We are to rendezvous back at the Senate building.''"<br />"''What? No, no, no, no; the Outer Rim, not the Senate you stupid machine!|HELIOS-3D and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]]|audio=3DOZiro.flac|<ref name="HC" />}}
[[File:3D_herds_Orn_Free_Taa.png|thumb|left|200px|3D escorting Senator Free Taa]]
3D was part of Cad Bane's posse and took part in [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|the operation]] to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] from Republic custody. His job was to escort [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] with a pardon disc authorizing Ziro's release. They traveled in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] towing a sled for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] behind it. When Ziro was released and boarded the transport, 3D piloted it back to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], where the rest of the team, including [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] boarded the craft and left the crime scene unhindered.<ref name="HC" />

===Iego===
After the successful rescue of Ziro, the group descended into the lower levels of Coruscant where Bane instructed the members of the posse to disappear somewhere the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] wouldn't find them.<ref name="HtH1">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part I)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part I)]]</ref> 3D traveled to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] and hid on the wreckage of an [[HELIOS-3D's Munificent-class star frigate|abandoned]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] left by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in a section of Iego's orbit known as "[[Thicket|the Thicket]]." Establishing its own [[HELIOS-3D's droid army|droid army]], the droid managed to reactivate and reprogram several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] left behind when the Separatists abandoned the [[Iego system/Legends|system]] as well as part of the [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]]<ref name="HtH3" /> that had been [[Mission to Iego/Legends|previously deactivated]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="MoaTM">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>

When [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], a resident of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], noticed activity in the skies over Iego, he launched several probes into orbit to find out what he was seeing. All of his probes stopped transmitting data at which point Hood notified the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fearing a return of the Separatists. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] dispatched Skywalker and Kenobi to verify the reports. 3D was actually the one intercepting and reprogramming the probes, including the unmanned drones the Republic was sending into the Thicket. After two [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were destroyed while searching the Thicket,<ref name="HtH3" /> more [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] were launched and managed to eliminate the remaining droid forces. Skywalker, Kenobi, and Hood ventured into the debris field aboard [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] and discovered the abandoned ''Munificent''-class frigate housing 3D.<ref name="DOI">{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/droids_over_iego|text=Droids Over Iego|int=Droids Over Iego}}</ref>

The three [[Human/Legends|Humans]] found the deactivated shell of 3D aboard the bridge of the frigate and Hood asked if he could salvage the droid. Skywalker refused to state they had to study the dangerous droid, removing and taking the head with them. In truth, however, 3D had transferred its consciousness to one of its [[B1-series battle droid]]s.<ref name="DOI bonus">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]] bonus page</ref>
